NFL Week 16 Observations

- The Ravens put up a good fight despite losing Lamar Jackson in the first half of this contest, so I’ll stop short of calling this an impressive win for Drake Maye and the Patriots.

- Mike Vrabel and Maye are going to make the Patriots a 10+ win team virtually every year going forward, and Maye had a good looking second half, but I really wanted to see New England, who has benefited from a very easy schedule, get pushed by even a semi dangerous team one more time.
